segments.text: Lesson 46
segments.translation: 第46课

segments.text: Do it yourself
segments.translation: 自己动手

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: Did the writer repair his lawn mower in the end? Why/Why not?
segments.translation: 作者最后修理好他的割草机了吗？为什么？/为什么没有？

segments.text: So great is our passion for doing things for ourselves,
segments.translation: 我们对凡事亲自动手的热情是如此之大，

segments.text: that we are becoming increasingly less dependent on specialized labour.
segments.translation: 以至于我们越来越少地依赖专业劳动。

segments.text: No one can plead ignorance of a subject any longer, for there are countless do-it-yourself publications.
segments.translation: 由于有无数的“自己动手”出版物，再也没有人可以借口对某一学科一无所知了。

segments.text: Armed with the right tools and materials, newlyweds gaily embark on the task of decorating their own homes.
segments.translation: 新婚夫妇准备好了合适的工具和材料，愉快地开始装饰自己的家。

segments.text: Men, particularly, spend hours of their leisure time installing their own fireplaces,
segments.translation: 男人们，特别是那些，花好几个小时的业余时间安装自己的壁炉、

segments.text: laying out their own gardens; building garages and making furniture.
segments.translation: 规划自己的花园、建造车库和制作家具。

segments.text: Some really keen enthusiasts go so far as to build their own computers.
segments.translation: 一些真正的爱好者甚至亲自动手组装自己的电脑。

segments.text: Shops cater for the do-it-yourself craze not only by running special advisory services for novices,
segments.translation: 商店不仅通过为新手开设专门的咨询服务，

segments.text: but by offering consumers bits and pieces which they can assemble at home.
segments.translation: 还通过向消费者提供可以在家组装的零部件，来迎合这种“自己动手”的热潮。

segments.text: Such things provide an excellent outlet for pent up creative energy, but unfortunately not all of us are born handymen.
segments.translation: 这些事情为被压抑的创造力提供了一个极好的排遣渠道，但遗憾的是，并不是我们所有人都是天生的能工巧匠。

segments.text: Some wives tend to believe that their husbands are infinitely resourceful and can fix anything.
segments.translation: 有些妻子倾向于认为她们的丈夫足智多谋，什么都能修。

segments.text: Even men who can hardly drive a nail in straight are supposed to be born electricians, carpenters, plumbers and mechanics.
segments.translation: 即使是那些连钉子都钉不直的男人，也被认为是天生的电工、木工、水管工和机械师。

segments.text: When lights fuse, furniture gets rickety, pipes get clogged, or vacuum cleaners fail to operate,
segments.translation: 当保险丝烧断、家具摇晃、水管堵塞或吸尘器无法工作时，

segments.text: some women assume that their husbands will somehow put things right.
segments.translation: 有些妇女总以为她们的丈夫会想办法把事情搞定。

segments.text: The worst thing about the do-it-yourself game is that sometimes even men live under the delusion that they can do anything,
segments.translation: “自己动手”这个游戏最糟糕的一点是，有时甚至连男人也生活在他们无所不能的错觉中，

segments.text: even when they have repeatedly been proved wrong.
segments.translation: 即使他们已经被一再证明是错的。

segments.text: It is a question of pride as much as anything else.
segments.translation: 这既是一个自尊心的问题，也是其他任何问题。

segments.text: Last spring my wife suggested that I call in a man to look at our lawn mower.
segments.translation: 去年春天，我妻子建议我请个人来检查一下我们的割草机。

segments.text: It had broken down the previous summer, and though I promised to repair it, I had never got round to it.
segments.translation: 它在去年夏天就坏了，虽然 I 答应过要修，但我一直没腾出功夫来。

segments.text: I would not hear of the suggestion and said that I would fix it myself.
segments.translation: 我听不进这个建议，并说我要自己修。

segments.text: One Saturday afternoon, I hauled the machine into the garden and had a close look at it.
segments.translation: 一个星期六的下午，我把机器拖到花园里，仔细观察了一下。

segments.text: As far as I could see, it needed only a minor adjustment:
segments.translation: 据我观察，它只需要一点微调：

segments.text: a turn of a screw here, a little tightening up there, a drop of oil and it would be as good as new.
segments.translation: 这儿拧一下螺丝，那儿拧紧一点，滴一滴油，它就会像新的一样了。

segments.text: Inevitably the repair job was not quite so simple.
segments.translation: 不可避免地，修理工作并非那么简单。

segments.text: The mower firmly refused to mow, so I decided to dismantle it.
segments.translation: 割草机硬是不动，所以我决定把它拆开。

segments.text: The garden was soon littered with chunks of metal which had once made up a lawn mower.
segments.translation: 花园很快就堆满了金属块，这些金属块曾构成了一台割草机。

segments.text: But I was extremely pleased with myself. I had traced the cause of the trouble.
segments.translation: 但我对我自己极其满意。我已经找到了故障原因。

segments.text: One of the links in the chain that drives the wheels had snapped.
segments.translation: 驱动轮子的链条中的一环断了。

segments.text: After buying a new chain I was faced with the insurmountable task of putting the confusing jigsaw puzzle together again.
segments.translation: 买来新链条后，我面临着一个无法克服的任务：把这个令人困惑的拼图重新拼凑起来。

segments.text: I was not surprised to find that the machine still refused to work after I had reassembled it,
segments.translation: 发现重新组装后机器仍然拒绝工作，我并不感到惊讶，

segments.text: for the simple reason that I was left with several curiously shaped bits of metal which did not seem to fit anywhere.
segments.translation: 理由很简单：我剩下了几块形状古怪的金属片，似乎哪儿也安不上去。

segments.text: I gave up in despair.
segments.translation: 我绝望地放弃了。

segments.text: The weeks passed and the grass grew.
segments.translation: 几周过去了，草长长了。

segments.text: When my wife nagged me to do something about it,
segments.translation: 当我妻子唠叨我处理一下时，

segments.text: I told her that either I would have to buy a new mower or let the grass grow.
segments.translation: 我告诉她，要么我买台新割草机，要么让草继续长。

segments.text: Needless to say our house is now surrounded by a jungle.
segments.translation: 不用说，我们的房子现在被一片丛林包围了。

segments.text: Buried somewhere in deep grass there is a rusting lawn mower which I have promised to repair one day.
segments.translation: 在深草丛中的某个地方埋着一台生锈的割草机，我曾答应过有一天要修好它。
